title: airBaltic Files Chapter 11, American Eyes Singapore Again, and a Cargo Plane's Owner Gets the Boot
summary: Latvia's flag carrier heads to a New York bankruptcy court while insisting flights keep flying — turns out betting big on a single aircraft type has a dark side too. Plus, American Airlines might return to a route it once ran away from, Amazon cuts ties with the cargo airline behind last week's Miami runway overrun, and a shouting match on the tarmac in Atlanta raises real questions about who actually has the final word before takeoff.
